summary: Inflect v2: natural American English speech at 24 kHz from a model of under 10M parameters. Runs on the CPU, many times faster than real time. Two voices: Micro (best quality, 38 MB) and Nano (16 MB, faster); each downloads the first time it speaks. English only.
author: Subtitld
license: GPL-3.0-or-later (add-on, because it bundles espeak-ng, GPL-3.0-or-later); Inflect v2 weights Apache-2.0

voices.display_name: American English man (Inflect Micro, best quality)
American English man (Inflect Nano, smaller and faster)

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 picks half the logical processors, at most 8.

fields.label: Speaking pace
fields.help: How fast Inflect itself speaks: 1.0 is its natural pace, 1.2 is 20% faster. The dubbing rate slider still stretches the result afterwards.

fields.label: Variation
fields.help: How much the delivery varies from take to take: 0 is flat and always the same, higher is livelier. 0.667 is Inflect's default.
